page.overview:
What is Snowy Peaks of Crudelis?

The Snowy Peaks of Crudelis are a location in Dissidia Final Fantasy Opera Omnia. This is the fourth region of the game and can be explored in the fourth chapter of the story mode.

See Dissidia Final Fantasy Opera Omnia Story Act 1 script#Ch.4 Snowy Peaks of Crudelis

There are fifth locked gateways located on Snowy Peaks of Crudelis.
